parole.testo: A Turkic loanword before the times of Carpathian conquest in 9th and 10th centuries. Attested in 1446 as Old Hungarian gazolcodic (ďāsolkodik, “to be bereft”), from Old Chuvash *ďās, ultimately from Proto-Turkic *yās. Compare Eastern Mari сӧс (sös, “funeral celebration”) from the same Turkic root. C
